articles.summary: New York, November 9, 2026 – Lazard Asset Management (“LAM”) today announced its entry into fixed income ETFs with the launch of three actively managed strategies: Lazard US High Yield ETF (NYSE Arca: HYB), Lazard Hybrid Financial Income ETF (NYSE Arca: HYFY), and Lazard Non-Dollar Active Income ETF (NYSE Arca: XDLR). Each is managed by a specialized Lazard investment team and designed to give investors differentiated sources of income.
articles.title: Lazard Asset Management Launches Its First Three Fixed Income ETFs, Providing Investors New Ways To Access Differentiated Income
